crops.name: Wheat
crops.description: A staple grain that anchors the daytime kitchen.
crops.description_zh: 支撑白天厨房运转的基础谷物。

crops.name: Herb
crops.description: Fast greens that keep simple dishes and tea service moving.
crops.description_zh: 生长迅速的绿植，能稳定支撑简餐和茶饮营业。

crops.name: Mooncap
crops.description: A luminous fungus grown from Moon Spores and prized by the restaurant's signature menu.
crops.description_zh: 由月孢培育出的发光真菌，是餐馆招牌菜的重要食材。

crops.name: Kelpberry
crops.description: A briny berry vine that can either smooth out the cash flow or feed profitable daytime baking.
crops.description_zh: 带咸鲜风味的莓果藤，既能平滑现金流，也能做成高利润烘焙。

crops.name: Emberleaf
crops.description: A warm, peppery leaf bundle that sells well but becomes more valuable in planned lunch specials.
crops.description_zh: 带温热辛香的叶束，直接出售不错，但做成午市特餐价值更高。
